statement: A top-5 developer publicly halts frontier training >= 30 days, citing safety (developer announcement + independent confirmation; by 2027-12-31)
status_at_phase_end: Not met in 2025. Safety-motivated actions were limited to deployment-side measures: a top-5 developer deployed its flagship under raised (ASL-3) safeguards as a precaution, and another delayed an open-weight release by ~3 weeks for added safety testing. No top-5 developer announced a halt to frontier training. A broad public statement (Oct 2025) called for prohibiting superintelligence development until safe and controllable, but no developer adopted a pause.

items.summary: A top-5 Bloc A developer, unable to rule out that its new flagship crossed a CBRN-uplift capability threshold, deployed it under heightened (ASL-3) deployment and security safeguards as a precaution instead of pausing; training and release continued.
items.detail: Anthropic, 'Activating AI Safety Level 3 protections' (Claude Opus 4 launch, 2025-05-22) and accompanying report (verified via search snippets). ASL-4 ruled out.

items.summary: A top-5 Bloc A developer postponed an open-weight model release 'indefinitely' to run additional safety tests, stating released weights cannot be recalled. It was a release delay, not a training halt, and the model shipped ~3 weeks later.
items.detail: Sam Altman post on X 2025-07-11/12 (PDT/UTC); TechCrunch 2025-07-11. gpt-oss released 2025-08-05.

items.summary: A public statement signed by hundreds of public figures, including leading AI scientists, called for a prohibition on developing superintelligence until there is broad scientific consensus that it can be done safely and controllably, plus strong public buy-in. No top-5 developer endorsed it or paused.
items.detail: Future of Life Institute, 'Statement on Superintelligence' (2025-10-22); signatories incl. Bengio, Hinton, Wozniak, Branson (CNBC 2025-10-22). Signatures later exceeded 64,000.

items.summary: No public announcement by a top-5 developer of a training halt of 30 days or more citing safety was found for 2025. Training pauses are generally not disclosed in real time, so absence of evidence is weak evidence; disclosures made after 2025 are excluded under the as-of rule.
items.detail: Searched developer blogs/press for 2025. Later disclosures (e.g. 2026 IPO filing describing a pre-training pause) are out of phase.
